title: Teatro Dignidad presents ¡BOCÓN! by Lisa Loomer | College of Fine Arts
text:
Free Student & Community Performance
Join Teatro Dignidad for their closing weekend of ¡BOCÓN! a play by Lisa Loomer filled with joy, wonder and the voices of our vulnerable youth. Witness the journey of Miguel, an irrepressible bocón (big mouth), who suddenly loses his voice when his parents are taken. What follows is a powerful story of imagination, memory, resilience, and finding the courage to speak out.
With amazing performers and tech team, this performance will feature a partnership with the School of Music, and the vibrant TucSon Jarocho, creating a live and musically immersive theatrical experience.
